_comment: quality_suffix is appended to EVERY image-generation prompt (Cloudflare FLUX, Gemini, Pollinations); it is never skipped. Keep everything positive (say what you want): image models draw whatever the prompt names. style_dna is the look every picture shares. variants are visual families built from reference images you liked: each picture uses ONE family (rotated, never the same one twice in a row), takes at most two of its elements, and must add one new element from that day's topic, so pictures match in style but never copy a reference. The chosen family is saved on the draft as image.style_id and compared in the weekly learning review. Do not put text, numbers, brand names or layout words (panel, grid, section, column, diagram) in here. accent_rgb colours the headline highlight, glow and DM button of the card, including the designed chat card, so the family shows on every post.
quality_suffix: Ultra-sharp 4K resolution, highly detailed, crisp focus, clean edges, cinematic lighting with soft glow, rich contrast, high dynamic range, premium polished finish, vertical 4:5 composition.
style_dna: Premium, polished, high-contrast technology look with one clear glowing accent colour, clean modern shapes, a cinematic feel, and a large calm area across the lower 40% of the frame.

_slide_comment: slide_reference_prompts: your favourite image prompts as plain strings. Both the hook picture and every problem/solution slide picture are written in their style (subject, composition, lighting, environment, colour and mood, camera and texture). They are style examples only, never copied. Each variant also has lighting, materials and camera words used by the fallback prompt.
